examples.description: Reconcile a company's Altinn filings against Apier submissions

description: Reconcile a company's Altinn 3 filing history against the filings YOUR consumer submitted through Apier: each Altinn instance paired with its Apier audit record (`filed_via_apier` + `apier_record`). Cursor-paginated ({ cursor } from `pagination.next_cursor`, { limit } 1–100). Simulated today (ALTINN_MODE=mock by default) until Digdir grants the `altinn:instances.read` Maskinporten scope and the operator sets ALTINN_MODE=live. AUTH_NO_DELEGATION, VALIDATION_FAILED; a credential without `read:altinn` can't see the tool; a call returns unknown tool (-32602). For upcoming deadlines, use get_company_deadlines instead. No API key? Use Bearer apier_sandbox_test_<suffix> (a fresh suffix) to get fixtures; valid orgs are the 818, 99966 and 99977 series and 999000002 (see GET /api/v1/sandbox/fixtures). Cost: 50 øre (NOK 0.50) per call, prepaid (prices: the get_pricing tool or GET /api/v1/pricing; a shortfall returns INSUFFICIENT_CREDITS with top_up_url). Docs: https://www.apier.no/docs/guides/audit-inspection
description_nb: Avstem innsendingshistorikken i Altinn 3 for et selskap mot innsendingene DIN konsument leverte via Apier, sammenstilt med `filed_via_apier` + `apier_record`. Markørbasert paginering via `cursor` (limit 1 til 100; `offset` er utfaset). Simulert i dag (ALTINN_MODE=mock er standard) til Digdir innvilger scopet altinn:instances.read i Maskinporten og operatøren setter ALTINN_MODE=live. Krever read:altinn. For kommende frister, bruk get_company_deadlines i stedet. Kostnad: 50 øre (NOK 0.50) per kall, forhåndsbetalt (priser: verktøyet get_pricing eller GET /api/v1/pricing; for lav saldo gir INSUFFICIENT_CREDITS med top_up_url).

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token from the previous page's `pagination.next_cursor` - the canonical way to page.

org_number.description: 9-digit Norwegian organisasjonsnummer (Brønnøysund ID); MOD-11-checked up-front — a failing value is rejected as VALIDATION_FAILED, so correct the number rather than retrying it.

name: get_company_filing_history

outputSchema.description: Rule 34 envelope; failures set result null + metadata.error_code / retryable / remediation. Contract: https://www.apier.no/docs/mcp

result.description: The paired filing history: `data[]` Altinn instances (form code, title, agency, submitted_at, status, instance id) each with `filed_via_apier` + `apier_record` when Apier submitted it, plus a `pagination` block. No filings → empty `data[]`, not an error.

title: Company filing history (Altinn) + Apier audit trail
